newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Andina to invest $920 mln in Latam.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Andina to invest $920 mln in Latam.

text.p: Chilean bottler Embotelladora Andina announced plans Tuesday to invest up to $920 million in Latin American business projects between now and 1999.

Andina, the Coca-Cola Co's leading bottler in Chile, already has about $300 million of that figure committed to investments over the next three years in existing businesses in Argentina, Brazil and its home market, said executive vice president Erwin Han.
"The rest of the outlays will come from funds that we will raise over the next three years and which will be available for investment," said Han.

In Chile, Andina holds the franchise for Coke bottling and distribution in the capital Santiago and two nearby provinces. In Brazil, Andina operates mainly in Rio de Janeiro state through its subsidiary Rio de Janeiro Refrescos Limitada, while in Argentina it holds local franchises in the provinces of Crdoba, San Juan, Mendoza, Santa Fe and Entre Ros.
((-- Rodrigo Martnez/Roger Atwood, Santiago newsroom +56-2-699-5595 x211))
